posts.title: Can You Reconstruct the Decision?
posts.subheadline: Governance begins with a trace you can actually follow.
posts.caption:
An AI audit trail is useful only if someone can follow it after the moment has passed. Which prompt ran? What did the model return? What changed? Who reviewed it, and what happened next?

TRAICE records prompts, tokens, edits and agent actions alongside human oversight events, giving governance teams a clearer evidence chain to inspect. That does not make every output compliant by default; it makes the activity visible enough to review.

Explore TRAICE audit trails.

#TRAICE #AIGovernance #AIAuditTrail #ResponsibleAI #EUAIAct #RegTech

posts.title: A Policy Is Not an Audit Trail.
posts.subheadline: Operational evidence shows what the AI actually did.
posts.caption:
An AI governance platform cannot turn a policy document into evidence. A policy says what should happen. An audit trail shows which prompt ran, what the model returned, what changed, who reviewed it and when approval happened.

Regulated teams need both: the rule and the record. If your current process can only produce the first, you still have a visibility gap.

Save this distinction.

#TRAICE #AIGovernance #AIAuditTrail #ResponsibleAI #EUAIAct #RegTech

posts.title: Stop Collecting AI Tips.
posts.subheadline: Choose one real task. Build the useful version.
posts.caption:
AI for small business does not need another folder full of saved tips. Pick one task that repeats, costs time or regularly gets postponed. Write down what a useful result looks like, then build the smallest version that reaches it.

You will learn more from one imperfect working system than from fifty screenshots of tools you might try later. Keep the scope small enough to finish this week.

Save this and pick your one task.

#JosephConlan #CloneCentre #PracticalAI #AIForSmallBusiness #AICoaching #AICommunity

posts.title: Build AI Around People.
posts.subheadline: Useful systems. Human control. Clear accountability.
posts.caption:
Human-first AI is decided in the boring details: who can stop a workflow, who reviews an output, and what evidence remains afterwards.

That is why Clone Centre starts with the job people are trying to do—not with a model demo. Useful systems keep human control visible and accountability clear. If the result looks impressive but nobody can explain or challenge it, the design is unfinished.

Follow @CloneCentre for practical human-first AI.

#CloneCentre #HumanFirstAI #ResponsibleAI #AIGovernance #AIProductDevelopment #UKTech

posts.title: Compliance Starts at Design.
posts.subheadline: Governance works better before deployment, not after it.
posts.caption:
Responsible AI development starts before the first production prompt. It starts when the team decides what data enters the system, where review happens, who can intervene, and what gets recorded.

Adding governance after launch usually means rebuilding choices that were treated as ‘just technical’. Put those questions into the design brief while they are still cheap to answer.

Save this principle for your next AI project.

#CloneCentre #HumanFirstAI #ResponsibleAI #AIGovernance #AIProductDevelopment #UKTech
